title: How long “should” it take to create a project with AI assistance?
author: Codingology
selftext:
I know this is a very subjective question but I’d like to see through the comments the average time span you guys took / are taking to make a game. Obviously it depends by the vastness of the content, but I feel we could find an average.  
It’s been 1 month and half for me since I started using Claude for the coding, however, some 3d models and the UI was ready years ago, so I’m working with things already done. Realistically it would have taken me maybe 2 months and an half / 3 to be in the current state that I am if I had started from 0.  
To finish the game I believe it will take me yet another 2 months. So let’s say that for me it is about 6 months time. What about you?
